source.publication: local-unpublished; repository credential lacks push access

scope: Seven remaining declarations from the complete eleven-declaration internal/losslessxml test family; four parser/QName/boundary/normalization declarations stay indexed in go-xml.json. Source-reviewed Go lexical-edit predicates only; new scenarios planned, no Go or cross-runtime execution credit. contracts/go-lexical-editing.md reconciles the full family denominator and gaps.

verifiedAspects: Three exact output strings compare an existing unqualified single-quoted attribute, an existing namespace-bound double-quoted attribute and a fresh attribute without reserialising the sibling
A duplicate edit to one attribute in a batch returns a non-nil error
gaps: Source also refuses an unbound attribute namespace, reserved xmlns, illegal text character and invalid local name; new candidate only covers duplicate edits
No post-refusal output or independent reparsed attribute-value assertion; Go quote choice is an observed source predicate, not a general XML requirement

verifiedAspects: Inserted child and grandchild are reparsed with expanded element names new/x and empty-namespace plain, and untouched sibling keep remains a byte substring
Overlapping root/child insertions refuse; a separate nil insertion returns source bytes exactly
gaps: The test asserts element identities but does not read back the inserted attribute or grandchild text
Bad:name, NUL, mixed Text+Children, foreign target and duplicate-parent insertion refusals remain outside the two candidate scenarios

verifiedAspects: The literal hello leaf is one of five seed inputs; parsing does not mutate caller bytes and an empty edit returns the exact source bytes
gaps: The fuzz callback returns without assertion for rejected or over-limit XML inputs; nonempty edits may fail, and successful output is only reparsed. Those conditional paths are not mapped as a success contract
No arbitrary generated input, guaranteed nonempty replacement, exploratory fuzz campaign or performance credit

verifiedAspects: The feature lists the exact four root XML sources and five namespace URI choices for each element and attribute, giving 100 deterministic source loop iterations. Reparse checks root, child and grandchild expanded names, deep-equal attribute values and exact grandchild text
Each original root source is retained by a separate empty edit
gaps: One source declaration and one workflow, not one hundred independently named canonical cases
No exact serialized prefix, output part hash, independently measured runtime leaves or complete namespace matrix beyond specified values

verifiedAspects: Three literal seed tuples feed the callback; when text and attribute are valid, output reparses and child text, expanded name and full attribute values equal the supplied node
gaps: Fixture seed count does not establish an exploratory fuzz run or an exhaustive string space; inputs over 4096 bytes return
Invalid values require a non-nil error but have no exact error code, unchanged-output or package-level assertion; candidate insertion fixture differs from this fuzz callback

verifiedAspects: Removing two disjoint elements yields one exact output retaining comment, namespace declaration and gap; separate nil removal equals original source bytes
Root and parent/child overlapping selections return non-nil errors in separate Examples rows
gaps: Duplicate, foreign and zero-value targets also refuse in source but have no candidate row here
No post-refusal package rollback or encoded part-custody assertion; one further removal proves parsed snapshot reuse without exact output comparison

verifiedAspects: Replacing a subtree under surviving parent namespace scope yields an exact output string with bound-prefix new and empty-namespace plain
Root, duplicate target and parent/child overlapping selections return errors with nil edited output in separate Examples rows; separate nil replacement equals original source bytes
gaps: Disjoint replacement-plus-deletion has a separate exact source assertion not reproduced in the new candidates
Foreign target and invalid NUL text refuse, but are not represented here; no canonical package/Office-level validation
